review.gallery: Ten OMNIYAT renders from the original furnished collection brochure hosted by The Foundry. The tower for the Resort Residences leads the card. The estate-wide image and pool are labelled as shared.
review.location: The developer explicitly publishes the same estate point for both collections. The destination map covers the estate. Madena estimates are labelled with their nearby reference point and used as a guide for the shared area.
review.floorPlans: Eleven original furnished simplex plans. Eight complete PDF pages and three distinct full-resolution RE House sheets. The alternate earlier C2 sheet prints 1,800 sq ft versus 1,798 sq ft on the selected brochure page. The brochure labels its 2,469 sq ft example as 2 BR Type H while the current developer schedule lists a 3 BR double-height simplex at the same area. The supplied drawing stays labelled as printed. The earlier third-party elevation legend also differs from the current duplex bedroom configuration and is not used as a floor plan.

unavailable: Complete current 3 BR double-height and duplex drawings, surveyed visitor entrance, and verified finished-building photography.
